title: Verify: Lock held and per-attempt timeout unit tests
summary: Unit tests for foreign lock preservation and per-attempt timeout
description: Add tests in a new file using fakeAgent, fakeTrees and the temp-dir rig from newRunner; no real Git or provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given the lock file exists, When Run is called, Then the lock file still exists and the store has no record
Given a blocking agent, Timeout 20ms and MaxRetries 1, When Run is called, Then calls is 2 and error wraps context.DeadlineExceeded

steps.action: Build h via newRunner(t, Config{}, agent); create the file h.cfg.LockPath with os.WriteFile; call h.r.Run(ctx,"EXEC-1","ROUND-0000001"); assert errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked), os.Stat(h.cfg.LockPath) succeeds, h.st.Get("EXEC-1") returns an error and agent.calls is 0.
Use fakeAgent{block:true} and Config{Timeout:20*time.Millisecond, MaxRetries:1}; call Run; assert errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) and agent.calls == 2.
